title: Browns add a player to take JOK’S roster spot

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Browns add a player to take JOK’S roster spot
sources.description: On Friday, the Cleveland Browns announced that they claimed DT Elijah Chatman off waivers from the New York Giants. The Browns had a roster spot open up when they placed LB Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah on the reserve/physically unable to perform list earlier in the day.
